questions.q: Why did the lesson pin the base image to python:3.10-slim rather than the newest Python?
options: Newer Pythons cannot run FastAPI
scikit-learn 1.1.2 had no matching wheel for Python 3.11, so the base image must match the training stack
Slim images only exist for Python 3.10
Docker refuses to run any newer Python
questions.explain: pip could not find scikit-learn==1.1.2 for Python 3.11 on Linux (versions started at 1.1.3), so the image must match the stack the model was trained with.

questions.q: Why is requirements.txt copied and installed BEFORE the application code is copied?
options: So Docker can cache the slow install layer and skip it when only app code changes
Because pip refuses to run after code is copied
So the model loads faster at runtime
Because Docker copies files alphabetically
questions.explain: Docker caches layers in order. Dependencies rarely change, so putting them first lets code edits rebuild quickly.

questions.q: What does --host 0.0.0.0 do in the CMD line?
options: Turns on GPU support
Makes the server listen on all interfaces so it is reachable from outside the container
Disables input validation
Publishes the port to the host automatically
questions.explain: Uvicorn listens on 127.0.0.1 by default, which cannot be reached from outside the container. Ports are still published with -p at run time.

questions.q: What is the main trade-off of copying the model file into the image?
options: It ties one model version to one image tag, which is traceable, but changing the model means building a new image
It makes the model less accurate
It stops the container from starting
It makes the API slower for every request
questions.explain: Baked-in models are simple and traceable. Fetching a registered model at startup lets you update without rebuilding but needs credentials and extra handling.

questions.q: In this lesson, what is the honest status of the Dockerfile?
options: It was built and load-tested in production
It was built on a cloud registry
It was not built here because Docker was not installed; dependency pins were checked with pip download
It was generated by an AI and never reviewed
questions.explain: Docker was not available in the authoring environment, so the file follows official guidance and its pins were checked separately. Learners should build and test it themselves.
